## Hello, I am Emilie Peynaud

Welcome to my website. Here you will find an overview of my research and engineering work in numerical simulation and scientific computing for the life sciences.

My work at CIRAD (French agricultural research centre for international development) in Montpellier focuses mainly on developing numerical tools to 
solve problems formulated as partial differential equations, with applications to the representation of plant dynamics, in order to address 
questions in ecology and agroecology.

I originally trained in scientific computing at INSA Toulouse. During my PhD at CERFACS (Toulouse), 
I worked on simulating the propagation of acoustic waves in fluids with subsonic flow.
